name: Multichannel Signal Processing
description:
Wave equation: Solution to wave equation, introduction to spherical harmonics, and mathematical preliminaries of multichannel signal processing. 
Acoustic source localization: Data model, correlation, and subspace-based (MUSIC, root-MUSIC) localization, wideband and narrowband source localization, source activity detection, localization, and tracking. 
Brain Source Localization (BSL): Brain anatomy, Neurophysiology of brain, sLORETA and MUSIC for BSL, Application of BSL in BCI control.
Source Estimation: Fixed beamforming, null steering, adaptive beamforming, and beampattern design. 
Multichannel signal enhancement: Time and frequency domain-based enhancement, joint diagonalization, noise rejection, binary masking, and beamforming.
More Application: Source separation, dereverberation
